entities.summary: Sanan Devahastin na Ayudhya, better known by his noble title Chaophraya Thammasakmontri, was an educator, writer and senior government officer of Siam/Thailand. He served as Minister of Public Instruction from 1915–1926, and was the first President of the National Assembly, serving from 28 June – 1 September 1932 and from 15 December 1933 – 26 February 1934.
